_nota: Capa inglesa de Contarte. Trae solo el aparato: la entrada de la sala, la linea de cada cuento, su procedencia y los metadatos. Los cuentos y sus titulos se quedan en español y salen marcados con lang=es.
frase: Contarte: the room where the stories live.
intro: Those ancient words announce a story. Some of my stories live here, each with a place of its own and a hand held out, inviting you in.
Some are free, still unattached. Some come from books waiting to see the light. Some are cheerful, others dark. But all of them are ready to keep you company.
The story, that sprite that has kept humanity company since the dawn of time, still gives away magic, realities and even fears.
aviso: The stories are published in their original Spanish, as all literary texts on this site are.

avisos_adultos.erotico: A work of erotic literature, written for adult readers.
avisos_adultos.duro: A story for adult readers: a minor's sexualised delusion, and a death by her own hand.

seo_titulo: Stories by Antonio López Sánchez, in Spanish
seo_desc: Seven complete stories by the Cuban writer Antonio López Sánchez, published in their original Spanish, each with a page of its own.

la-muneca-y-el-principe.linea: A dragon has appeared in Pilar's toy room. But it will take a prince to face it.
la-muneca-y-el-principe.procedencia: Published in Cuentos de muñecas (¡A leer y a jugar!), edited by Magaly Sánchez Ochoa, Editorial de la Mujer, 2015
la-muneca-y-el-principe.seo_titulo: La muñeca y el príncipe, a story by Antonio López Sánchez
la-muneca-y-el-principe.seo_desc: A complete children's story by Antonio López Sánchez, in Spanish: Pilar's toys prepare her birthday, and a prince is needed. From Cuentos de muñecas, 2015.

aquelarre.linea: Six very special friends must complete an arcane rite to survive in today's world.
aquelarre.seo_titulo: Aquelarre, a story by Antonio López Sánchez
aquelarre.seo_desc: A complete story by Antonio López Sánchez, in Spanish: six friends meet in a Havana apartment, and the evening ends in a ritual with a new leader.

asesinato.linea: The downstairs neighbour was afraid of a tree. So she decided to kill it...
asesinato.seo_titulo: Asesinato, a story by Antonio López Sánchez
asesinato.seo_desc: A complete story by Antonio López Sánchez, in Spanish: a neighbour fears the tree on the pavement and goes down with petrol and rags. A balcony sees the rest.

clinica-del-miedo.linea: A patient breaks down on the couch of a most unusual specialist.
clinica-del-miedo.seo_titulo: Clínica del miedo, a flash story by Antonio López Sánchez
clinica-del-miedo.seo_desc: A complete flash story by Antonio López Sánchez, in Spanish: a patient confesses his fear to a very patient specialist. It reads in a minute.

duelo.linea: Two figures face each other in the snow. A duel between unequal opponents...
duelo.seo_titulo: Duelo, a flash story by Antonio López Sánchez
duelo.seo_desc: A complete flash story by Antonio López Sánchez, in Spanish: two figures face each other on the snow, and a shot rings out. It reads in a minute.

luces.linea: A writer caught between power cuts tries to make literature and keep up with the housework.
luces.seo_titulo: Luces, a story by Antonio López Sánchez
luces.seo_desc: A complete story by Antonio López Sánchez, in Spanish: the power comes back, and with it the washing machine, the hose held high and a story never written.

sombreros-pamelas-y-magicas-varitas.significado: Hats, Sun Hats and Magic Wands
sombreros-pamelas-y-magicas-varitas.linea: Brujito Sombrero is woken by a sonata, and on the other side of the fence a magic wand goes by.
sombreros-pamelas-y-magicas-varitas.seo_titulo: Sombreros, pamelas y mágicas varitas, a story in Spanish
sombreros-pamelas-y-magicas-varitas.seo_desc: A complete story by Antonio López Sánchez, in Spanish: Brujito Sombrero is woken by a Scarlatti sonata, and a magic wand passes beyond the fence.

cantar-el-cuento-iii.linea: Part of a trilogy where the stories sound like songs too. Adolescent love and its passions, sung between two bodies.
cantar-el-cuento-iii.procedencia: From Oleaje de pianos, a book now with its publisher
cantar-el-cuento-iii.seo_titulo: Cantar el cuento (III), a story by Antonio López Sánchez
cantar-el-cuento-iii.seo_desc: A complete story by Antonio López Sánchez, in Spanish: the last day of a training camp, a letter written as a song, and a bed freshly made.

la-urna-del-tio.linea: A vivid portrait of life and its turns, told by the ashes of a dead man.
la-urna-del-tio.procedencia: From El color de las decisiones, a book now with its publisher
la-urna-del-tio.seo_titulo: La urna del tío, a story by Antonio López Sánchez
la-urna-del-tio.seo_desc: A complete story by Antonio López Sánchez, in Spanish: a dead man tells from his clay urn how the room filled up with relatives, and how he ended on the floor.

traje-de-lluvia.linea: Rain calls up dreams and literature at once, and lets you live inside them.
traje-de-lluvia.seo_titulo: Traje de lluvia, a story by Antonio López Sánchez
traje-de-lluvia.seo_desc: A complete story by Antonio López Sánchez, in Spanish: a downpour empties the avenue, and a woman in a dress of rain sits down on the opposite pavement.

hipo-talamo.linea: A journey through a child's mind, its ambivalences, and a horror that may be real or imagined.
hipo-talamo.seo_titulo: Hipo-Tálamo, a story by Antonio López Sánchez
hipo-talamo.seo_desc: A story by Antonio López Sánchez, in Spanish, for adult readers: a girl turning fifteen prepares her wedding feast for someone who exists only at night.
